description: Store and share files in Backblaze B2 cloud storage: upload, download, copy, hide and delete files, make temporary download links, manage buckets, and start a workflow when a new file arrives.

backblaze_b2_new_file_trigger.description: Runs for each file added to a Backblaze B2 bucket, or to one folder in it, and again when a file's contents are replaced. Files already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It looks at up to 10,000 files in the folder, so pick a folder for a bigger bucket. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.bucket_id: The bucket the file is in.
output.content_type: The file's type, such as application/pdf.
output.file_id: The file version's id, for 'Get file info' or 'Copy file'.
output.file_name: The file's whole path in the bucket, such as incoming/june.pdf.
output.name_only: The last part of the name, such as june.pdf.

parameters.description: The Backblaze B2 bucket to watch.
parameters.name: bucket_id

parameters.description: Only watch files whose name starts with this, such as incoming/. Leave empty to watch the whole bucket.
parameters.name: prefix
